abstract: Covers RFC 7208 Sender Policy Framework (SPF) version 1: the v=spf1 DNS TXT record, its mechanisms, qualifiers, modifiers and macros, the check_host() evaluation of the MAIL FROM and HELO identities, the seven results, the DNS lookup and void lookup limits, record size, flattening and forwarding, and recording results with Received-SPF, Authentication-Results (RFC 8601) and the RFC 7372 status codes. It lists two version lines: RFC 7208 (current, updated by RFC 7372, RFC 8553 and RFC 8616) and RFC 4408 (legacy, upgraded from). SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions and upgrades, record syntax, evaluation and results, and limits and pitfalls.
